scope: Read-only mathematical/source review of the local-maxima replacement and exact polyline figure; no source edits.
text_checks: The complete first convex-fold proof is byte-identical to the supplied snapshot.

The second construction matches Construction B.2 of the locally reviewed ICLR 2025 version; the published journal version places it at Construction 6.2. The chapter correctly cites the local edition and identifies the exposition used for the attribution to Kripfganz–Schulze.

Refinement by equality hyperplanes fixes the order of the affine formulas. Every M_i is nonempty because it contains i. The cited lattice representation supplies f=min_i u_i; it is not incorrectly inferred merely from local equality.

Each u_i is convex CPWL. The sum g and maximum of the complementary sums h are convex CPWL; h=g-min_i u_i=g-f establishes the exact identity. The singleton case uses an empty complementary sum equal to zero.
